summary: Grupo Cibest S.A., a Colombian bank, filed its Q2 2026 quarterly report via Form 6-K. The report discloses a share buyback program authorized by shareholders on March 24, 2026, for up to COP 1,350,000,000,000 (~$1.35 trillion) over three years. As of June 30, 2026, the company repurchased 4,398,970 shares (common, preferred, and ADRs converted to preferred), with the corporate group repurchasing 17,165,034 total. The program transfers COP 431.4 billion from legal reserve to the buyback reserve. Watch ongoing repurchase pace and impact on share counts.
